body: Addressed. Output paths resolve existing parents and final symlinks, including dangling links, before the distinct-path check. The mandatory ledger is published first and both files use atomic replacement, separating existing hard links. CLI regression cases cover these paths; their installed-binary execution is not claimed locally. Principles 4 and 7.

Addressed. Project and lift now attach the actual source or reference path and matching operation context to read and parse diagnostics, retaining the original cause and location fields. CLI regression cases cover missing and malformed input/reference files. Installed-binary execution remains unrun locally. Principle 7.

Addressed. When a close correspondence supplies a selected STATO class, the emitted loss boundaries include both the canonical class and skos:closeMatch. Exact correspondences remain unchanged. The regression inspects the actual emitted ledger. Principles 7, 17 and 19.

Addressed. Both outbound matrix and inbound cube denominators now use canonical integer parsing before the zero comparison. This catches signed, padded and whitespace-bearing zero while retaining the invalid-denominator failure. Principle 7.

Addressed. XML whitespace is trimmed before variable-name validation and declaration minting. The regression verifies that plain and surrounding-whitespace spellings share one free declaration. Principle 7.

Addressed the native-ownership defect: SKOS predicates on an external identifier no longer establish a canonical symbol. Native references require explicit mathematical classification; reverse alignments require a unique typed canonical subject. I declined accepting reverse closeMatch as native identity: approximate outbound alignment does not establish exact reconstruction. The documented profile and regression explicitly retain that refusal. Principles 7, 17 and 19.

Declined the optional cache optimization. The declared complete mappings-product dependency is correct; the consumer selects GRAPH_ALIGNMENTS for its semantic input. Narrowing authenticated dataflow invalidation would change the cache contract without a measured benefit and is unnecessary for this correctness change. Principle 4.
Addressed. The loss-ledger example now refers to its target artifacts, with matching French and Chinese source and translated entries. Principle 4.

Addressed using the canonical validation model: allValuesFrom plus maxQualifiedCardinality and explicit closed-world ClosureEntry records require one source and one target name. I did not use the suggested unqualified cardinality because repository law forbids it. No shape surface is hand-authored. Principles 4 and 17.
